l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha iqondo lobushushu apho ibango liphuka khona.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.explain: −50°C yi-1.8×(−50)+32=−58°F. −58 incinci kuno-−50, ngoko ibango lokuba inani leFahrenheit likhulu liyaphuka.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuguqula i-−50°C ibe yiFahrenheit kunika i-−58°F, kwaye −58 incinci kuno-−50, ngoko ibango liyaphuka.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s2.model.1: Ngenani elinegethivu, ukuphindaphinda nge-1.8 kuliza lincinci, ngoko nasemva kokongeza u-32 liba ngu-−58. Inani leFahrenheit lincinci, ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba f=g=x, ngoko ∫x²dx=1/3, kodwa isiphumo samaxabiso e-∫x dx singu-1/4, ngoko amaxabiso amabini ayahluka kwaye ngumzekelo ochasayo.

l-m-h3-b0d09-15.material: Imbono: kwi-vektha a engeyiyo i-vektha engu-zero, ukuba a·b = a·c ngoko b = c. Nge-a = (1, 0), fumana b kunye no-c ababonisa ukuba le mbono iphosile.

l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.r.c: b kunye no-c yi-vektha enye, ngoko azinakuyophula imbono.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.r.d: a·b=1 kunye no-a·c=2, ngoko iimveliso zamachaphaza aziyalingani.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.explain: Ukuba a=(1,0), a·b yingxenye ye-x ka-b. Ukuba iingxenye ze-x ziyalingana kwaye iingxenye ze-y ziyahluka, iimveliso zamachaphaza ziyalingana kodwa b≠c.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s2.model.0: a·b=3 kunye no-a·c=3, ngoko iimveliso zamachaphaza ziyalingana, kodwa iingxenye ze-y zika-b noka-c ziyahluka, ngoko b≠c. Lo ngumzekelo ochasayo.

l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B). Ngumlinganiselo, phakathi kweemeko apho u-B yenzeka, apho u-A yenzeka nayo.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s2.model.0: Isebenzisa kuphela iimeko apho u-B yenzeka njengesalathiso, ngoko inani elingaphantsi ngu-P(B) kwaye inani elingasentla lifuna u-P(A∩B), ithuba lokuba zombini zenzeke kunye.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s2.model.1: Ngo-P(A) no-P(B) kuphela, awukwazi ukuba zenzeka kangaphi kunye, ngoko akunqunywanga, kwaye ingqinelano iyafuneka.

l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.o.a: Ukuba icandelo elinye linefom ye-derivative yelinye icandelo
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.r.b: Kukho iimeko ezininzi apho ufaka endaweni nokuba asiliqhezu.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.r.c: Ezinye ii-integral, ezifana no-x·eˣ, ziziphumo zokuphindaphinda kodwa azinakwenziwa ngokufaka endaweni.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.r.d: Nangomsebenzi we-trigonometri, ii-integral ezininzi aziyidingi ukufaka endaweni.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.explain: Ukuba inefom ∫g(f(x))f'(x)dx, ungabeka u=f(x) uyiguqule ibe ∫g(u)du.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba icandelo elinye liphindaphindwa yi-derivative yelinye, ngoko xa lisetwa njengo-u, u-du ufanela ncam, ngoko ukufaka endaweni kusebenza.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s2.model.1: U-f'(x)dx kufuneka abe ngu-du ukuze ibinzana liguquke libe yi-integral ka-u kuphela, ngoko isiseko kukuba ifom ye-derivative ikhona nayo.

l-m-h3-b0d08-20.material: Kwi-n=1, 2, 3, i-fₙ(x)=x·e^(−nx) inexabiso eliphezulu kwi-x=1, 1/2, 1/3 ngokulandelelana. Sebenzisa ipatheni ukuqikelela i-x apho ubuninzi bubakho xa n=5.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.prompt: Xa n=5, yeyiphi i-x enkulu kakhulu?
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.r.a: Kwi-n=1 yi-1, ngoko inani elingaphantsi yi-n, hayi i-n−1 (nge-n−1, i-n=1 ayinakusebenza).
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.r.d: Icala apho i-x incipha njengoko n ikhula liphethukile.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.explain: Ukusuka kwi-fₙ'(x)=(1−nx)e^(−nx)=0, x=1/n, kwaye itshintsha ukusuka ku-+ ukuya ku-− macala omabini, ngoko bubuninzi.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s2.model.0: 1, 1/2, 1/3 zonke zinemo ye-1/n, ngoko kwi-n=5, x=1/5, kwaye ukwenza i-derivative kunika (1−5x)e^(−5x)=0, nayo engu-x=1/5, ngoko ichanekile.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s2.model.1: Uphawu lwe-fₙ'(x)=(1−nx)e^(−nx) lutshintsha ukusuka ku-+ ukuya ku-− kwi-x=1/n, ngoko xa n=5 i-x enkulu kakhulu yi-1/5.

l-m-h3-b0d08-33.s.s2.model.1: Umlinganiselo kwilungu elingaphambili ngeendawo ezimbini yi-(n−1)/n, ohambelana nazo zonke iimeko, ngoko siqikelela u-I₅=I₃×4/5=8/15.

l-m-h3-b0d09-03.title: Ngumthetho muni ukhoyo womgama ukuya kwi-focus?
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.goal: Fumana uze uchaze ipatheni kwimizekelo emininzi yomgama phakathi kwechaphaza kwi-parabola ne-focus, uze ujonge loo patheni ngemeko entsha.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.material: Imigama esuka kumachaphaza (1, 2), (4, 4), (9, 6) kwi-parabola y² = 4x ukuya kwi-focus (1, 0) yalinganiswa yafunyanwa ingu-2, 5, 10 ngokulandelelana.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.prompt: Ngumthetho muni phakathi kweekhowudinethi zechaphaza nomgama walo ukuya kwi-focus?
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.r.a: Kwi-(4, 4), umgama o-5 wahlukile kwikhowudinethi ye-y esi-4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.r.d: Kwi-(1, 2) umgama ngu-2, kodwa le ntetho inika u-3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.explain: Kuwo onke amachaphaza amathathu, umgama yikhowudinethi ye-x+1. Idityaniswa nenkcazo ye-parabola: umgama ulingana nomgama oya kwi-directrix x=−1.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s2.model.0: (1,2) inika u-2, (4,4) inika u-5, kwaye (9,6) inika u-10, zonke zilingana ne-x+1, ngoko ungafumana umthetho umgama = x+1.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s2.model.1: Umgama oya kwi-directrix x=−1 yi-x+1, kwaye kwi-parabola imigama eya kwi-focus nakwi-directrix iyalingana, ngoko umgama oya kwi-focus nawo yi-x+1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-10.material: Sifumene ii-asymptote ze-hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1. Xa (a, b) = (2, 3), y = ±3x/2; xa (4, 1), y = ±x/4; kwaye xa (1, 5), y = ±5x.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.prompt: Ngumthetho muni phakathi kwethambeka lee-asymptote no-a, b?

l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.explain: Kuzo zontathu iimeko ithambeka li-±b/a. Ii-asymptote zifana ne-y=±(b/a)x, efunyenwe kwi-x²/a²−y²/b²=0.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s2.model.0: (2,3) inika i-3/2, (4,1) inika i-1/4, kwaye (1,5) inika i-5, zonke zilingana ne-b/a, ngoko umthetho kukuba ithambeka li-±b/a.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s2.model.1: Ukumisela x²/a²−y²/b²=0 kunika y²=(b²/a²)x², ngoko amathambeka kwimizekelo ayasilingana ne-b/a.

l-m-h3-b0d10-33.s.s1.explain: Amachaphaza asesangqeni sesiqwenga anelisa u-x²+y²=169−k². Ngoko r=√(169−k²), ohambelana nazo zonke iimeko ezintathu.

l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s1.r.b: Ngabantu abangama-30, liphezulu kunama-50% malunga kwabantu aba-23.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s1.explain: Amabini angama-435×1/365≈1.2 amabini, ngoko ithuba lokungabikho nakubini lingama-30% malunga. Ngoko ithuba lokuba likho li-70% malunga.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba ibini ngalinye kwama-435 linoku-1/365, inani lamabini elilindelekileyo li-1.2 malunga, ngoko ithuba lokungabikho nakubini lingama-30% malunga, nto leyo ilenza libe ngama-70%.
l-m-h3-b0c49-16.s.s2.model.1: Kufuneka ubale amabini, hayi abantu, ngoko ama-8% asuka ku-30÷365 mancinci kakhulu njengoqikelelo.

l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.0: y²=128 ilele phakathi kwe-11²=121 ne-12²=144, ngoko y ingaphezulu kancinci kune-11, malunga nama-11.

l-m-h3-b0c47-18.goal: Landela ngamanyathelo isisombululo esifumana umahluli oqhelekileyo omkhulu we-252 ne-105 usebenzisa i-algorithm ka-Euclid, okanye ikhonkco lembangela nesiphumo, ufumane uze ulungise apho kuqala ukuphosakala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.material: Esi sisisombululo esifumana umahluli oqhelekileyo omkhulu we-252 ne-105. ① 252 = 105×2 + 42 ② 105 = 42×3 + 21 ③ 42 = 21×2 + 0 ④ Umahluli u-21, kanye phambi kokuba intsalela ibe ngu-0, ngumahluli oqhelekileyo omkhulu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.r.d: Isigqibo sichanekile. I-252 ne-105 zombini ziziphindaphindo zika-21.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.explain: 42×3+21=147, okungeyiyo i-105. 105 = 42×2 + 21 ichanekile. Impendulo yokugqibela, u-21, isachanekile.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s2.model.0: 42×3+21=147 ayinikeli i-105, ngoko ② yindawo apho kuqala ukuphosakala. Kufuneka ilungiswe ibe yi-105 = 42×2 + 21.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s2.model.1: Ukuphindaphinda u-42 ngo-3 kunika i-126, ngoko intsalela evela kwi-105 ayiyi kuba ngu-21. I-84, eyi-42 ephindaphindwe ngo-2, kunye no-21 yenza i-105, ngoko ② kufuneka ilungiswe.

l-m-h3-b0c47-19.goal: Landela ngamanyathelo isisombululo esenza unxantathu one-engile engqukuva ngentambo enamafindo, okanye ikhonkco lembangela nesiphumo, ufumane uze ulungise apho kuqala ukuphosakala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.material: Kukho indlela yokwenza i-engile engqukuva ngentambo ehlulwe yaba ngamacandelo ali-12 ngamafindo. ① Yenza amacala amathathu ngamacandelo ama-3, ama-4, nama-5 ② 3+4+5=12, ngoko yonke intambo iyasetyenziswa ③ 3²+4²=25=5², ngoko ungunxantathu one-engile engqukuva ④ I-engile engqukuva yenziwa phakathi kwecala elinobude obu-3 necala elinobude obu-5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.o.a: ① Amacala amathathu angamacandelo ama-3, ama-4, nama-5
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.r.a: Intambo yamacandelo ali-12 ingahlulwa ibe ngama-3, ama-4, nama-5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.r.b: 3+4+5=12, ngoko yenza ilophu enye ngqo yentambo.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.o.d: ④ I-engile engqukuva iphakathi kwamacala angama-3 nama-5

l-m-h3-b0c47-20.title: Ukufumana umlinganiselo wegolide: ngowuphi umgca ongumpazamo wokuqala?
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.goal: Landela ngamanyathelo isisombululo esifumana umlinganiselo wegolide, apho icala elide liphindwe ngamaxesha angama-1.618, okanye ikhonkco lembangela nesiphumo, ufumane uze ulungise apho kuqala ukuphosakala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.material: Ukuba unxande onecala elide u-x necala elifutshane eli-1 unomlinganiselo wegolide, ngoko x:1=(x+1):x. ① x² = x+1 ② x²−x−1=0 ③ x=(1±√5)/2 ④ Ekubeni ubude bungamanani apozithivu, x=(1−√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.a: Kumlinganiselo, imveliso yamalungu angaphakathi ilingana nemveliso yamalungu angaphandle, ngoko ichanekile.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.b: Lulingano x²=x+1 kunye nayo yonke into ifudusiwe kwicala elinye, ngoko ichanekile.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.c: Ukubeka a=1, b=−1, c=−1 kwifomula yeqwadratiki ichanekile.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.explain: (1−√5)/2 ingamalunga ne-−0.618, inani elingelilo apozithivu. Ubude lelo lipozithivu, (1+√5)/2≈1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.0: √5≈2.236, ngoko (1−√5)/2 ingamalunga ne-−0.618, inani elingelilo apozithivu, kwaye ayinakuba bubude. Yilungise ibe yi-(1+√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.1: Ubude bungapozithivu, ngoko kufuneka ukhethe eyona ngcambu inkulu kuzo zombini, (1+√5)/2≈1.618, kodwa ④ ikhethe ingcambu encinci.

l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.b: Ukuthabatha inani elifanayo kumacala omabini kulungile.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.c: Yahlula macala omabini nge-(a−b) ukuze ufumane a+b=b
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.d: Ukubala okufaka a=b kuchanekile. Ingxaki ikumgca wangaphambili.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.explain: Ukuba a=b, ngoko a−b=0, ngoko oku kwahlula nge-0. Ukwahlula nge-0 akuvumelekanga.

l-m-h3-b0d08-14.goal: Landela isisombululo sokufumana i-derivative ye-y=x/(x²+1), okanye ikhonkco lalo lonobangela nesiphumo, inyathelo ngenyathelo, ufumane apho siphosa khona okokuqala, uze ulungise.
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.material: Ukwahlula i-y=x/(x²+1): (1) f=x, g=x²+1, ngoko f'=1, g'=2x (2) y'=(f'g−fg')/g² (3) inani elingaphezulu 1·(x²+1)−x·2x=x²+1−2x (4) y'=(x²−2x+1)/(x²+1)²
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.o.a: Umgca (1): apho f' kunye ne-g' zafunyanwa khona
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.o.c: Umgca (3): apho inani elingaphezulu labalwa khona
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.o.d: Umgca (4): apho intetho yenziwa lula khona
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.r.d: Umgca (4) ukopa isiphumo somgca (3), ngoko asiyondawo yokuqala ephosileyo.
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.explain: x·2x=2x², ngoko inani elingaphezulu li-x²+1−2x²=1−x². Ngoko y'=(1−x²)/(x²+1)².
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s2.model.0: x·2x ngu-2x², hayi u-2x, ngoko umgca (3) uphosile. Inani elingaphezulu elichanekileyo li-1−x², kwaye y'=(1−x²)/(x²+1)².

l-m-h3-b0d09-21.material: Esi sisisombululo se-engile θ phakathi kuka-a=(2, 1) no-b=(1, −3). ① a·b = 2−3 = −1 ② |a|=√5, |b|=√10 ③ cosθ = −1/(√5+√10) ④ Ngoko θ ibanzi
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi i-engile ibanzi kuba cosθ ayilunganga
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.r.d: Isigqibo sokuba i-engile ibanzi xa cosθ<0 sichanekile.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.explain: Umqondiso kufuneka uphindaphindwe: |a||b|=√5·√10=5√2. Ekubeni cosθ=−1/(5√2)<0, isigqibo siyafana, kodwa intetho yayiphosile.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s2.model.0: Ekubeni cosθ=a·b/(|a||b|), umqondiso yimveliso yobungakanani, √50=5√2. Inyathelo ③, elibhale isixa, liphosile, kwaye ixabiso elilungisiweyo li-−1/(5√2).
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s2.model.1: Ifomula yahlula i-a·b ngemveliso ye-|a| kunye ne-|b|, ngoko akufunekanga uzongeze. Kufuneka ilungiswe ibe yimveliso ukuze ixabiso lichane.

l-m-h3-b0d09-36.goal: Landela isisombululo sokufumana umgama phakathi kwechaphaza nomgca, okanye ikhonkco lesizathu nesiphumo, inyathelo ngenyathelo. Fumana indawo yokuqala eyaphosakalayo uze uyilungise.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.material: Isiseko somgca othe ngqo ukusuka kwichaphaza P ngaphandle kwenqwelomoya α ukuya ku-α ngu-H, kwaye isiseko somgca othe ngqo ukusuka ku-H ukuya kumgca u-l okwi-α ngu-Q. Esi sisisombululo sokufumana umgama ukusuka ku-P ukuya ku-l xa PH=3 no-HQ=4. ① PQ⊥l ② ∠PHQ=90° ③ PQ=3+4=7 ④ Umgama ngu-7
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.a: PQ ⊥ l kuchanekile ngethiyori yemigca emi-3 emi ngqo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.b: U-PH uma ngqo ku-α, ngoko kuchanekile.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthatha umgama ukusuka ku-P ukuya ku-l njenge-PQ
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.r.d: Kuba PQ ⊥ l, kuchanekile ukuba PQ ngumgama.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s1.explain: Kunxantathu oyiyo ingile ye-PHQ, PQ²=3²+4²=25, ngoko PQ=5. Akufuneki udibanise ubude bamacala amabini.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s2.model.0: Unxantathu PHQ unengile eyiyo ku-H, ngoko ngethiyori kaPythagoras PQ²=9+16=25 kwaye PQ=5. Inyathelo ③, elidibanise 3+4, alilunganga.
l-m-h3-b0d09-36.s.s2.model.1: I-hypotenuse yonxantathu oyiyo ingile mfutshane kunesixa samacala amabini, ngoko u-7 akalunganga, kwaye kufuneka alungiswe abe ngu-5.

l-m-h3-b0d10-08.material: Esi sisisombululo sokufumana i-hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 enee-focus (±5, 0) kunye ne-eksisi etransverse enobude obungama-6. ① I-eksisi etransverse 2a=6, a=3 ② I-focus c=5 ③ b²=a²+c²=9+25=34 ④ x²/9 − y²/34 = 1
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.a: Ubude be-eksisi etransverse yi-2a, ngoko a=3 ilungile.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.explain: Kwi-hyperbola, c²=a²+b², ngoko b²=c²−a²=25−9=16. Ulingano yi-x²/9−y²/16=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.0: I-hyperbola ine-c²=a²+b², ngoko b²=c²−a² kufuneka ibe yi-16. Ukuyibhala ngokongeza kwi-③ kuphosakele.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba b²=34, ngoko c²=9+34=43, kwaye ii-focus zazingayi-(±5,0). Ngoko 34 iphosakele kwaye 16 ilungile.

l-m-h3-b0d10-09.material: Esi sisisombululo sokufumana k ukuze umgca y = x + k uthinte iparabola y² = 4x. ① (x+k)² = 4x ② x² + (2k−4)x + k² = 0 ③ Uyathinta, ngoko D>0, oko kukuthi −16k+16>0 ④ Ngoko k<1
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.r.b: Ukufaka ukuze kufunyanwe indawo yokuthinta yindlela elungileyo.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.explain: Xa uthinta, kukho indawo enye yokunqumlana, ngoko D=0. Ukusuka kwi-−16k+16=0, k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s2.model.0: Ukuthinta kuthetha ukuba kukho indawo enye yokunqumlana, ngoko D=0 iyafuneka. D>0 yixa umgca udibana nejika kwiindawo ezimbini. Yilungise ibe yi-k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba D>0, umgca udibana nejika kwiindawo ezimbini ezahlukileyo, ngoko awuthinti. Xa D=0, k=1.

l-m-h3-b0d10-22.material: Esi sisisombululo sokufumana ithanjenti kwichaphaza Q(3, 4) kwisangqa x² + y² = 25. ① Ithanjenti ime nkqo kwirediyasi OQ ② Kwichaphaza P kwithanjenti, OQ·OP = 0 ③ 3x + 4y = 0 ④ Ithanjenti ngu-3x+4y=0
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s1.r.a: Ithanjenti ime nkqo kwirediyasi kwichaphaza lokuthintela, ngoko oku kuchanekile.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s1.o.c: Ukuvumela ichaphaza kwithanjenti libe yi-P(x, y)
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s1.r.c: Ukuvumela ichaphaza libe yi-(x, y) kuchanekile.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s1.explain: Ithanjenti kufuneka idlule kwichaphaza lokuthintela Q, ngoko OQ·QP=0. 3(x−3)+4(y−4)=0, oko kukuthi, 3x+4y=25.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s2.model.0: Kwichaphaza P kwithanjenti, i-vektha eme nkqo kwi-OQ yi-QP, ngoko OQ·QP=0. 3x+4y=0 idlula kwimvelaphi kwaye ayinakuba yithanjenti.
l-m-h3-b0d10-22.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba OQ·OP=0, umgca udlula kwimvelaphi, ngoko awudluli kwichaphaza lokuthintela Q(3,4), kwaye uphosile.

l-m-h3-b0c47-23.material: Umlinganiselo wegolide φ (malunga nama-1.618) uhlangabezana ne-φ = 1 + 1/φ. Fumana olunye ulingano olithetha into enye nalo.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ulingano olithetha into enye nolokuqala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.b: Luyasebenza kuphela xa φ=2. Kodwa φ ingamalunga nama-1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba ucima φ kumacala omabini, ufumana 0=1, okungelona inyani.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.explain: Phindaphinda amacala omabini nge-φ kwaye ufumana φ² = φ + 1. Ukuba φ≈1.618, onke amacala angamalunga nama-2.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.0: Ukuphindaphinda amacala omabini nge-φ kunika φ²=φ+1, ngoko lithetha into enye nolulingano lokuqala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.1: Ukufaka φ=1.618 kunika φ²≈2.618 kwaye φ+1=2.618, ngoko zombini ulingano zinika ixabiso elifanayo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-05.title: Ukuguqula isixa esithile n/(n+1) sibe lilungu eliqhelekileyo
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.goal: Chaza ilungu eliqhelekileyo aₙ lesixa esithile Sₙ=n/(n+1) ngolunye uhlobo (ulingano, itheyibhile, umzobo, amagama), uze uchaze isizathu sokuba zithetha into enye.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.material: Isixa soluthotho Σaₙ ukusuka kwilungu lokuqala ukuya kwilungu lesibalo n yi-Sₙ=n/(n+1). Chaza uthotho olufanayo ngelungu eliqhelekileyo aₙ.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.a: S₂−S₁=1/6, kodwa eli binzana linika a₂=2/3, ngoko lahlukile.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.c: Xa n=1 linika i-1/4, kodwa a₁=S₁=1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.explain: aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁. n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n=1/{n(n+1)}, kwaye isebenza nakwi-n=1, inika i-1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.0: Ilungu eliqhelekileyo lumahluko wezixa ezithile ezikufutshane, Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁, ngoko ukubeka n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n phezu kwenani elingaphantsi eliqhelekileyo kunika i-1/{n(n+1)}.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.1: S₁=1/2 kwaye S₂−S₁=1/6, kwaye ukufaka amaxabiso kwi-1/{n(n+1)} kunika i-1/2 ne-1/6, ngoko lulo uthotho olufanayo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-32.title: Ukuguqula umda wolandelelwano ube yi-integral echanekileyo
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.goal: Chaza lim Σ(2/n)f(1+2k/n) ngenye indlela (ulinganiso, itheyibhile, umfanekiso, amazwi), uze uchaze ukuba kutheni zithetha into enye.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.material: U-f uqhubeka. Bhala lim(n→∞) Σ(k=1~n) (2/n)·f(1+2k/n) njengee-integral echanekileyo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi i-integral echanekileyo elingana nalo mda?
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.a: U-2/n bububanzi bolwahlulo, ngoko awuphindaphindi ngo-2 ngokwahlukileyo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.b: Ixabiso ngaphakathi ku-f li-1+2k/n, ngoko u-x usuka ku-1 ukuya ku-3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.c: Ubude bolwahlulo bu-(2/n)×n=2 kwaye luqala ku-1, ngoko luphela ku-3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.explain: U-2/n bububanzi, kwaye u-x=1+2k/n uhamba ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-3. Ngoko ngu-∫₁³ f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.0: Ukuqokelela iziqwenga ezingu-n zobubanzi obungu-2/n kunika ubude obungu-2, kwaye u-x=1+2k/n usuka ku-1 uye ku-3, ngoko ngu-∫₁³ f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.1: Xa k=1, u-x mkhulu kancinci kuno-1, kwaye xa k=n, u-x=3, ngoko ulwahlulo lu-[1,3]. Yiyo loo nto lulingana nale integral echanekileyo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-38.material: f iqhubeka. Sebenzisa ukufaka endaweni u=2x ukubhala ∫₀³ f(2x)dx njenge-integral ku-u.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s1.r.b: Xa x=3, u=6, ngoko isiphelo sethuba kufuneka sitshintshe nasiso.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s1.r.d: U-1/2 okufuneka uphindaphindwe xa kuguqulwa u-dx kube yi-du ulahlekile.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s1.explain: Ukuba u=2x, ngoko du=2dx, ngoko dx=du/2, kwaye xa x ihamba ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-3, u ihamba ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-6.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s2.model.0: Ukusuka ku-du=2dx, dx=du/2, kwaye ukuba x=3 ngoko u=6, ngoko iba (1/2)∫₀⁶ f(u)du.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s2.model.1: Ithuba litshintsha libe ngu-0 ukuya ku-6 kwaye dx sisiqingatha sika-du, ngoko intetho yoqobo ilingana ne-(1/2)∫₀⁶ f(u)du.

l-m-h3-b0d07-08.goal: Linganisa zonke iimeko ezichasanayo kwisixa sonyaka wokuqala senkxaso-mali encipha unyaka ngamnye, ukhethe ukuvumelana okufanelekileyo, uze uchaze isizathu.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.material: Inkxaso-mali inikwa unyaka ngamnye. Unyaka wokuqala yi-a (nge-10,000 won), kwaye unyaka ngamnye olandelayo ngamaxesha angu-r unyaka odlulileyo. Nokuba iqhubeka ngonaphakade, isixa sizonke kufuneka sibe yi-100 × 10,000 won ubuninzi, unyaka wesibini kufuneka ube ngama-70% unyaka wokuqala ubuncinane, kwaye unyaka wokuqala kufuneka ube ngowona mkhulu.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi icebo eneliseka zonke iimeko ngelixa lenza unyaka wokuqala ube mkhulu kakhulu?
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.a: Ihlangabezana neemeko, kodwa unyaka wokuqala unokwenziwa mkhulu ngaphakathi kwesixa sizonke se-100 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.c: Isixa sizonke yi-35/0.3≈116.7 × 10,000 won, edlula i-100 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.d: Isixa sizonke yi-100 (ngeeyunithi ze-10,000 won), kodwa unyaka wesibini ngama-60%, esilela kuma-70%.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.explain: Isixa sizonke yi-a/(1−r)≤100 kwaye r≥0.7. Xa r=0.7, a≤30, ngoko i-30 × 10,000 won kunyaka wokuqala yeyona inkulu.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s2.model.0: r kufuneka ibe ngama-0.7 ubuncinane kwaye isixa sizonke a/(1−r)≤100, ngoko a=30 kwi-r=0.7 ngowona mkhulu, nto leyo yenza eli cebo lifaneleke kakhulu.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s2.model.1: Ukunyusa r kuncipha a≤100(1−r), kwaye ukuyehlisa r kuphula imeko yama-70%, ngoko r=0.7, a=30 kukuvumelana.

l-m-h3-b0d07-35.material: Isitya senziwa ngokujikelezisa ihlaka u-y=√x (0≤x≤h) ejikeleze i-axis ye-x (iyunithi: cm). Umthamo kufuneka ube ngu-50π cm³ okanye ngaphezulu, ukuphakama u-h kufuneka kube ngu-12 cm okanye ngaphantsi, kwaye xa u-h encinci, kusetyenziswa impahla encinci.

l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.r.a: Umthamo ungu-32π, nto leyo engafikeleliyo ku-50π.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.r.c: Uhlangabezana neemeko, kodwa usebenzisa impahla ngaphezu kuka-h=10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.r.d: Ukuphakama kudlula umda we-12 cm (umthamo ungu-98π).
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.explain: Umthamo ngu-π∫₀^h x dx=πh²/2. Ukuba ubuncinane u-50π, u-h≥10 uyafuneka, kwaye esona h sincinci, h=10, sifaneleke kakhulu.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s2.model.0: Ukusuka kumthamo πh²/2≥50π, h≥10, ngoko ngaphakathi kokuphakama kwe-12 okanye ngaphantsi, u-h osebenzisa impahla encinci kakhulu ngu-10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s2.model.1: U-h=8 unomthamo omncinci kakhulu, kwaye u-h=12 nesi-14 basebenzisa impahla ngakumbi okanye badlula umda, ngoko u-h=10, ohlangabezana ngqo nemeko yomthamo, ufaneleke kakhulu.

l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s1.explain: Amandla avelisiweyo yi-∫₀¹² k·t(12−t)dt=288k, kwaye imveliso ephezulu ku-t=6 yi-36k. Yi-k kuphela eneliselayo zombini iimeko ngu-1.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s2.model.0: Amandla 288k≥288 anika k≥1, kwaye imveliso ephezulu 36k≤36 inika k≤1, ngoko k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d08-34.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba k incinci, amandla avelisiweyo ayasilela, kwaye ukuba k inkulu, imveliso igqitha umda, ngoko k=1, apho yomibini imida ihlangatyezwa kanye, kukuhlangabezana.

l-m-h3-b0d08-35.goal: Kwiphakama a lecandelo lomphanda y=a·x(2−x), linganisa zonke iimeko ezichasanayo, khetha ukuhlangabezana okufanelekileyo kakhulu, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.material: Icandelo lomphanda webhulorho yi-y=a·x(2−x) (0≤x≤2, iyunithi m). Ukuphakama okuphakathi a kufuneka kube ngama-3m ubuncinci, indawo yecandelo kufuneka ibe ngama-6m² ubuninzi, kwaye izinto ezincinci zingcono.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi a ehlangabezana neemeko ngoxa isebenzisa izinto ezincinci kakhulu?

l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s1.explain: Ukuphakama okuphakathi yi-a ku-x=1, kwaye indawo yi-∫₀² a·x(2−x)dx=4a/3. Izinto ezincinci kakhulu ezihlangabezana ne-a≥3 kunye ne-4a/3≤6 zikwi-a=3.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s2.model.0: Ukuphakama yi-a≥3, kwaye ukusuka kwindawo 4a/3≤6 sifumana a≤4.5, ngoko ukusebenzisa izinto ezincinci a encinci kakhulu =3 ifanelekile.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s2.model.1: a=2 isilela ekuphakameni kwaye a=6 igqitha umda wendawo, ngoko a=3, ehlangabezana nokuphakama kancinci, isebenzisa izinto ezincinci kakhulu.
